title: Providers
description: Provider-layer configuration as the provider layer loads it (PRD 6.4, 6.6, 14.1): models is config/models.yaml ($defs.models) and prices is config/prices.yaml ($defs.prices). The loader also checks that every role names existing profiles and every profile has a price entry, the speech role's rules below (1.2.0, ADR-0027), and the search role, unit price, region and valid_until rules below (1.3.0, ADR-0029). Model ids appear only in config/ and packages/providers.

capability.description: structured output (json), tool calling, vision, audio input, thinking levels, computer use, search grounding, code execution; 1.3.0 (ADR-0029): video input and documents (a PDF read natively, FR-INT-02).

example.description: true while the profiles are the PRD's examples; the user chooses final models.

roles.description: Business code asks for a role, never a model (PL-01). speech (1.2.0, ADR-0027) is the role every SpeechProvider call asks for (FR-MTG-17, FR-MTG-11, FR-INT-14, FR-CHN-16): the loader refuses it unless it states max_output_tokens and its primary, fallback and cascade profiles declare the audio capability and, while prices are set, carry an audio_input price. search (1.3.0, ADR-0029) is the role every SearchProvider call asks for (PRD 12.2): the loader refuses it unless it states reserve_units and its primary, fallback and cascade profiles declare the grounding capability and, while prices are set, carry a unit_price with unit query. Any role whose profiles carry a unit_price must state reserve_units.

profile.description: One model profile. Its cost rank (PRD 6.6) is derived from prices, never declared here. base_url and api_key_env are allowed only when provider is openai_compat (ADR-0002, ADR-0003). media_tokens (1.3.0, ADR-0029) holds the tokens the provider counts for one image, one PDF page and one second of audio or video, as upper bounds; the router uses them only for the pre-flight estimate and the EFF-03 cap check before it sends a media part, never for billing (the reported usage is billed). A profile without media_tokens gets no media part: the router refuses it before sending.

provider.description: Adapter name in packages/providers, e.g. google.

base_url.description: openai_compat endpoint. https only, with no user info, query or fragment, so no credential can sit in the URL (PRD 16.1 rule 4). The not-pattern rejects a final line break, which a Python validator's $ lets through.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the key, never the key itself. The not-pattern rejects a final line break, which a Python validator's $ lets through.

media_tokens.description: Tokens per unit of media input (ADR-0029 decision 6): image is one image, pdf_page one PDF page, audio_per_second and video_per_second one second. Upper bounds, so an estimate never understates.

role.description: reserve_units (1.3.0, ADR-0029) is how many units of the profile's unit_price the router reserves under the PL-03 budget check before it sends, because the provider cannot cap them (a grounded call runs as many searches as the model decides). A reply that reports no unit count is charged the reserved amount.

cascade.description: Profiles tried cheapest first; escalate only on schema failure, Verifier rejection or low confidence (PRD 6.6).

deny.description: Glob patterns of model ids that must never load (PL-07).

prices.description: Prices per profile (PL-06, FR-MTR-01). Prices, the date and the source may be null only while status is unset, and the loader refuses live metering until status is set. region (1.3.0, ADR-0029), optional, is the provider location the rates were quoted for (for example a regional endpoint's rates): the loader refuses live metering of a profile whose adapter sends to another location; an adapter with no location setting (fake, openai_compat) is not checked.

price.description: The rate charged, in US dollars per million tokens. audio_input (1.2.0, ADR-0027) is the price per million audio input tokens where the provider bills audio input at its own rate (Gemini); left out, the profile has no audio price and cannot serve the speech role. The other input tokens of the same call are priced at input. 1.3.0 (ADR-0029): cached_input is the price per million input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache (the Trace's tokens_cached, ADR-0022); left out, cached tokens are priced at input. unit_price is a fee per 1,000 units charged on top of the token rates (a call costs tokens times their rates plus units times per_1k / 1000). valid_until is the last calendar day (UTC) the price holds, for a promotional rate: after it the loader refuses live metering of the profile until the file is updated. Promotions, credits and free allowances are never subtracted here (the meter overstates, never understates).

unit_price.description: A fee per 1,000 units (ADR-0029 decision 1): query is one search the provider ran (Gemini grounding reports them in grounding_metadata.web_search_queries), minute one minute of audio, character one input character, image one generated image. per_1k is US dollars per 1,000 units, null only while prices are unset.
